text.description_html:
Acorn AM4BP, Smooth Iron Colonial Hook

A small reminder of the old world, the Colonial Hook made by Acorn is as functional as it is lovely. Perfect for hanging towels, keys, and even robes, it features an easy screw-in design and comes packaged with the mounting hardware. It has a smooth, matte black design that make it great for traditional and historic homes.

Features and Specifications of the Black Iron Coat and Hat Hook:

  • Finish: Smooth Black Iron
  • Material: Iron
  • Length: 3-1/4"

Sold Individually. Package includes: 1 hook and mounting screw.
